All string expressions inside double braces (such as state or user properties) and action handlers execute inside an isolated scope. Globals like window, document, and localStorage are masked, preventing cross-site scripting vulnerabilities and accidental DOM mutations.

children.children: How do I make a section utilize 100% of the display width?

Ensure the root container does not have max-w-* or mx-auto classes. You can click the 'Stretch Width' button in the builder top bar or canvas toolbar to automatically stretch the page to edge-to-edge full width.
Can I place components anywhere on screen rather than centered?

Yes! Use the 12-Column Grid or 3-Zone Canvas section presets. Child columns accept standard Tailwind grid placement classes like col-span-3, col-span-6, col-start-4, or flex-1 to position elements exactly where you need them.
How do actions communicate with the Elysia backend?

The sandbox context exposes the type-safe Eden Treaty client under 'elysia'. Actions can perform asynchronous calls like elysia.api.v1.media.get() and update state variables reactively using set('key', value).
